extrapolated.basis: a 900-block sample scaled by 48.0 to a day; a burst inside the window is scaled with it

caveat: EIP-3009 AuthorizationUsed is the settlement primitive x402's exact scheme uses, not a marker of the protocol. These figures are an upper bound on x402 volume and a measurement of gasless-authorized stablecoin transfer generally. The x402 share of this total is not established by this measurement.
